title: United States
html:
United States is a North American country map added to OpenFront in Update 33.0 by RickD004 — Large country map built for the new impassable terrain feature.

Nations

The map features 49 named nations, including California, Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Nevada and Arizona.

  • Categories: North America, Countries
  • Nations: 49
